name: SMP Server
description:
🌌 Astro SMP – Where the Entire Server Shapes the World

The world doesn't start infinite... you unlock it together.

🌍 Donate money with the community to permanently expand the world border.

⚡ Complete server-wide goals to unlock boosters that benefit everyone.

⚔️ Toggle your PvP for fast paced action or disable it to enjoy the peaceful experience 

👹 Battle massive custom bosses every week with rewards for every participant and bonus prizes for the top 3.

🎉 Work together to complete server-wide challenges like mining, fishing, farming, and more with rewards for every participant and bonus prizes for the top 3.

🤝 Form teams, build together, and unlock powerful team upgrades.

✨ Collect Stardust and Moonstone, trade it into Cosmic Shards, and trade powerful Astral Cores for exclusive custom items, cosmetics, and end-game rewards. 

💰 A balanced economy with Jobs, player shops, auctions, fishing, farming, mining, quests, and mcMMO that rewards long-term progression.

🏆 Frequent events, active staff, Bedrock support, land claiming, custom features, and a welcoming community.

Every dollar earned. Every block mined. Every boss defeated... helps the entire server grow.
